full_judgment: A.T.M. Afzal, CJ: A decree for ejectment of the defendant-petitioner, who was a monthly tenant in the suit premises, was passed by the Senior Assistant Judge, 3rd Court and S.C.C. Court, Dhaka in S.C.C. Suit No. 5 of 1994 brought by the plaintiff-respondents and the same has been upheld by a single Judge of the High Court Division by the impugned judgment and order dated 31st October, 1996 passed in Civil Revision No. 4186 of 1994 Now this petition for leave to appeal from the same.
